record.paper: Induced 2-degenerate Subgraphs of Triangle-free Planar Graphs

dossier_meta.paper: Induced 2-degenerate Subgraphs of Triangle-free Planar Graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: We believe the argument we use can be strengthened to give a bound $\frac{5}{6}$, however the technical issues are substantial and since we do not see this as a viable way to prove Conjecture 1.1 in full, we prefer to present the easier argument giving the bound $\frac{4}{5}$.
dossier_meta.context_text: Immediately after stating Theorem 1.2 (the $\frac{4}{5}$ bound), the authors remark that their method is likely improvable to $\frac{5}{6}$ but that pursuing this is not a practical route to proving the full $\frac{7}{8}$ conjecture.
